summary: Gelteq Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Special Meeting and Explanatory Statement for a shareholder meeting on June 19, 2026. The meeting appears to be a routine special meeting for corporate housekeeping or advisory matters, as the excerpt only describes proxy voting procedures and meeting logistics. No specific business resolution, transformative transaction, or special situation (e.g., acquisition, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing is a procedural notice, not a special-situation event.
